name: Quick Garlic Fingers
description: A simple and flavorful appetizer featuring garlic-infused margarine on flatbread topped with a blend of cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the margarine, garlic salt, oregano, basil, and thyme together until well combined.
Spread this mixture evenly on the cheese flat bread.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese over the top.
Place in a preheated oven at 350°F for approximately 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the edges are slightly golden and crusty if desired.

keywords: garlic fingers, cheesy bread, quick appetizer

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side

_similar.name: Mozzarella Spaghetti Skillet
_similar.description: A one-pot spaghetti dish cooked with hamburger, tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: Broken spaghetti to feed your family

recipeInstructions.text: In an electric skillet, brown the hamburger, onion, and green peppers.
Season with Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, water, and broken spaghetti to the skillet.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring frequently to prevent the spaghetti from sticking.
Simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Shortly before serving, add shredded mozzarella cheese and continue heating until melted.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti skillet, one-pot pasta, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread
